supply_assumptions: An owned Blisterwood flail from Sins of the Father is the intended input; optional 40,000-coin replacement is modeled if lost. Noble clothes and gear are assumed available but no optional cosmetic shop is forced.
Ivan provides a bronze pickaxe and tinderbox during the quest; other historical book and escape-puzzle items are quest-only proxies, with exact retention requiring game inspection.
Sangvesti escape uses a model of joined key halves, bolt cutters, water barrel, bank trapdoor, altar key and old cog. Optional escape resupply waypoints are deliberately not compulsory steps.

The Efaritay palace provides all stew ingredients and all Hallowed flail construction tools, diamond, enchant tablet and silver sickle; two blisterwood logs are provided before crafting, one more for the five stakes.
Hallowed flail is forged from a Blisterwood flail, enchanted diamond blisterwood sickle and Efaritay's hallowed marks using a hammer. The enchant tablet avoids assuming a rune supply.
All four Drakan encounters, the Wyrd, Maiden and Nylocas are distinct success-dependent planned outcomes, with no guessed incidental combat XP.
The post-quest XP package is one retained tome with six 30,000-XP picks, not six independent producer actions; Efaritay can reclaim a destroyed tome.
